name: Create a custom bot rule
description: Create a custom bot rule Add one bot rule to the project. POST /api/projects/{project_id}/web_analytics_bot_rules/
context:
POST /api/projects/{project_id}/web_analytics_bot_rules/
Add one bot rule to the project. A rule combines one or more single-property conditions with AND or OR. A pattern is rejected if it cannot run, because a broken rule would break every query that classifies traffic for the project.
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.; body (body)

name: Delete a custom bot rule
description: Delete a custom bot rule Remove one bot rule by its id. DELETE /api/projects/{project_id}/web_analytics_bot_rules/{id}/
context:
DELETE /api/projects/{project_id}/web_analytics_bot_rules/{id}/
Remove one bot rule by its id. The built-in bot list is unaffected.
Required: id (path); project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.

name: List custom bot rules
description: List custom bot rules The project's own bot rules, in the order they are checked at query time. GET /api/projects/{project_id}/web_analytics_bot_rules/
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/web_analytics_bot_rules/
The project's own bot rules, in the order they are checked at query time.
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
